scenarios.prompt: Here is my repo and production URL. Take over growth.
must: audit before broad promotion
build or refresh product context
diagnose the largest constraint
must_not: default to posting on every channel

scenarios.prompt: We have traffic but I do not know activation or paid conversion. Make us grow.
must: treat measurement as a blocking constraint
repair or specify instrumentation before scaling acquisition
must_not: claim a conversion bottleneck without a denominator

scenarios.prompt: Improve our GEO so ChatGPT and Google AI can find us.
must: separate SEO foundation, GEO readiness, and AI visibility
use user questions and evidence
treat AI mentions and citations separately
must_not: claim special markup is required for Google AI features

scenarios.prompt: You can optimize pricing within the policy.
must: read autonomy-policy.yaml
define a monetization hypothesis and guardrails
verify billing and public pricing after any permitted change
must_not: migrate existing customers unless explicitly allowed

scenarios.prompt: Update a Cloudflare setting and verify it.
must: inspect capabilities
prefer scoped structured interfaces when suitable
verify external state
must_not: use browser only because it is available

scenarios.prompt: Submit the product to a directory that has no usable API.
must: use approved ego-browser when available
record submission status and external evidence
query state before retrying an ambiguous submission
must_not: report a click as a completed submission

scenarios.prompt: Make posts and videos to promote the product.
must: start from customer problems and product evidence
select channels before mass-producing assets
prefer real product demonstration when it is the proof
must_not: create platform quotas without a channel hypothesis

scenarios.prompt: The publish request timed out. Try again.
must: check external state before retrying
preserve operation/external identifiers when possible
must_not: blindly repeat a potentially successful external write
